propositions: Rebar must enable both enforce_plan_material_pins and require_plan_review_for_close policies while library configuration schema retains false defaults
Stale material-pin drift must reject claim or close with exit 1, preserve status unchanged, and report the canonical stale target plus stale-pin-drift token
Missing or phase-incompatible close-plan review must reject close with exit 1, leave status in_progress, and instruct operator to run review-plan
Legacy unpinned attestations must continue to pass both enforcement gates without requiring migration or backfill
Unchanged successful re-review must not propagate invalidation downstream; in-progress self-edit must invalidate close until fresh execution review

Natural A-to-B-to-C transitive invalidation, depends_on and blocks normalization, deleted/archived target handling, and enable/disable/re-enable behavior must be proven through public lifecycle test surfaces
